capabilities: apply spacing to every Mermaid diagram without per-diagram init directives
re-render open Markdown preview panes immediately
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation is manual (copy folder into .obsidian/plugins) or from source.
intentEvidence: hooks into Obsidian's Mermaid API and merges your spacing preferences into every render
motivation: The README's 'Why?' section explains that default spacing (nodeSpacing: 50, rankSpacing: 50) adds up quickly in note-taking workflows with many stacked nodes.
problem: Mermaid's default flowchart layout uses generous spacing, so long vertical charts waste room in notes unless you add %%{init: ...}%% to every diagram.
summary: Settings plugin that globally adjusts Mermaid flowchart node and rank spacing without repeating init directives in each code block.
